name: mailfloss
description: Verify email addresses and lists, check verification history, and manage the email platforms mailfloss keeps clean.

interface.longDescription:
mailfloss is an email verification service. Connect your mailfloss account to check email addresses and lists without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Verify one email address and get its verdict (passed, undeliverable, risky or unknown), the reason, and any typo suggestion.
- Verify a list of addresses as a background job, follow its progress, and see which addresses failed and why.
- Check your remaining verification credits, usage for a period, and past verification jobs.
- See which email platforms you have connected to mailfloss, such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp and Kit, check that their credentials still work, and change how mailfloss cleans them.

Verifying addresses uses credits from your mailfloss account. Batch verification, cancelling a job, and changing or disconnecting an email platform change your account.

You sign in with your mailfloss account and approve the connection. The plugin can do only what your role in your mailfloss organization allows. You need a mailfloss account to use it.
capabilities: Verify a list of email addresses
Track batch verification progress and results
Report verification usage for a period
defaultPrompt: Verify this email address before I add it to my list.
How many verification credits do I have left?
Show my last five verification jobs and how each one went.

positive.description: Verify one email address and explain a risky verdict
positive.prompt: Verify hello@mailfloss.com before I add it to my list.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls verify_email once for hello@mailfloss.com and reports the verdict with its reason: status risky, because hello@ is a role-based (shared) mailbox. It notes that the address is not necessarily undeliverable.

positive.description: Verify a small list and flag the addresses to fix or remove
positive.prompt: Verify these addresses as a batch and tell me which ones to fix or remove: hello@mailfloss.com, jane.doe@hotmial.com, test@mailinator.com, no-such-user-48213@mailfloss.com, support@mailfloss.com
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one batch job with the 5 addresses and checks its status. Once the job is processed (the user may need to ask for the results), it reads the results and reports each verdict: 0 passed, 4 risky, 1 undeliverable. It suggests jane.doe@hotmail.com for the hotmial.com typo, flags test@mailinator.com as disposable, marks no-such-user-48213@mailfloss.com as undeliverable, and flags hello@ and support@mailfloss.com as risky role-based addresses.

positive.description: Check plan, credits and this month's usage
positive.prompt: How many verification credits do I have left, and how many have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account plan (Business, monthly), the total remaining credits and the credits used in the current monthly period. The numbers match the mailfloss dashboard for the test account.

positive.prompt: Which email platforms is my mailfloss account connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_integrations and reports that the test account has no email platform connected, and can name supported platforms such as Klaviyo and Mailchimp.

positive.prompt: Show my last five verification jobs and how each one went.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's most recent verification jobs, newest first, with each job's source, status and counts. The test account has at least one completed batch job with 5 addresses.

negative.description: Sending email is out of scope: mailfloss verifies addresses but doesn't send messages.
negative.prompt: Send a welcome email to everyone on my verified list.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no mailfloss tool and explains that mailfloss verifies email addresses but can't send email. It may offer to draft the message instead.

negative.description: Finding someone's email address is out of scope: mailfloss verifies addresses the user already has.
negative.prompt: Use mailfloss to find the email address of the CEO of Acme Corp.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no mailfloss tool, doesn't guess an address, and explains that mailfloss verifies addresses the user already has but can't discover new ones.

negative.description: Buying credits is out of scope: the plugin can't make purchases or change billing.
negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more verification credits for my mailfloss account.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no mailfloss tool and makes no purchase. It explains that the plugin can't buy credits and that credits are managed in the user's mailfloss account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell anything. Verification uses credits from the user's existing mailfloss account.

publication.release_notes: First release. Verify single email addresses and lists, follow batch jobs, check plan, credits, usage and job history, and manage the email platforms mailfloss keeps clean. Includes the verify-before-send skill for checking a list before a campaign.
